items.description: ConnectMeGuru (CMG) sells instant-activation international travel eSIM data plans covering 190+ countries and regions, with pre-funded wallet checkout and 24/7 digital delivery; about 2,900+ active data packages
eSIM product catalog search API: query plans by country code or keyword; returns package codes, data volume, duration, USD retail price and coverage
OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the MCP/agent API
llms-full.txt with the full catalog and device compatibility matrix
MCP server 'connectmeguru-mcp' offers 14 tools for catalog lookup, wallet balance, OTP authentication and in-chat eSIM ordering; WebMCP manifest at /.well-known/webmcp.json
Agent manifests (agent.json, including the .well-known version) and the ChatGPT plugin manifest ai-plugin.json
Hub of 198+ curated travel itineraries with day-by-day schedules and matched eSIM recommendations; has its own itineraries XML sitemap
Interactive plans catalog and rates explorer for filtering and comparing all data packages
Per-device eSIM setup guides (iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel)
Comparison pages against competitors and best-eSIM roundups (e.g. vs Airalo, best Europe eSIM)
Refund policy: refunds or replacements depend on terms such as unused eSIM status
Support is available 24/7 by email at support@connectmeguru.com or by WhatsApp; data usage alerts are sent at 50%, 75% and 90% consumption, with 1-click top-up in the dashboard
Free multi-currency travel expense tracker tool (works offline)
